transcript.text: Morgan, I need to flag a critical clearance issue before we can approve the broadcast plan. I confirmed with Northstar Archives this afternoon that the gala's licensed archival clip may be streamed live only to viewers in the United States, may not remain available as a replay, and requires the on-screen credit exactly 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives'. This directly conflicts with the draft distribution plan, which would stream worldwide and keep a replay available for seven days. I have the licensor's email in the clearance inbox but have not yet copied it into the broadcast plan.
